# DomesticShelters.org

> Comprehensive domestic violence resource hub connecting survivors with 3,000+ shelters, hotlines, educational tools, and community support networks across North America.

DomesticShelters.org provides integrated access to shelter directories, safety assessment tools, healing resources, and professional training for advocates. The platform serves survivors, professionals, and organizations working to end domestic violence through education, community connection, and evidence-based support.

## Key Topics

- domestic violence
- survivor resources
- shelter directory
- safety planning
- trauma recovery
- intimate partner violence
- legal resources
- healing resources
- professional development

- survivor stories
- abuse identification
- technology safety

## Core Resources & Homepage

- [Find Domestic Violence and Abuse Help, Information and Stats](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net): Homepage providing access to 3,000+ shelters, hotlines and DV resources
- [Heal](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/heal): Hub for healing resources, trauma recovery and survivor support tools
- [DV Professionals](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/for-professionals): Professional resources, training and tools for DV advocates and shelter staff

## Education & Assessment Tools

- [Identify Abuse](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/identify-abuse): Educational guide on identifying domestic violence and emotional abuse
- [Domestic Violence Assessment Tools](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/resources/risk-assessment-tools): Expert-vetted safety and danger assessment tools for DV situations
- [Comprehensive Guides Articles](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/articles/comprehensive-guides): Comprehensive guides on trauma recovery, restraining orders and legal resources
- [Domestic Violence Technology Safety Resources](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/domestic-violence-technology-safety-resources): Guides and tools for digital safety and protection from tech-enabled abuse

## Community Support & Directory

- [Domestic Violence Online Support](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/online-forums-and-chats): Directory of online support groups, forums and peer communities for survivors
- [Domestic Violence National/Global Resources](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/resources/national-global-organizations): Directory of national and global DV and sexual assault organizations
- [Domestic Violence and Sexual Assault State Coalitions (U.S.)](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/resources/state-coalitions): State-by-state directory of U.S. DV and sexual assault coalitions
- [Domestic Violence Provincial Groups (Canada)](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/resources/domestic-violence-provincial-groups-canada): Directory of Canadian provincial DV shelters and support organizations

## Learning & Media Resources

- [Mobile Apps for Victims and Survivors](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/resources/mobile-apps-for-victims-and-survivors): Curated mobile apps for safety planning, abuse documentation and support
- [Domestic Violence Podcasts](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/resources/domestic-violence-podcasts): Recommended podcasts featuring survivor stories and professional perspectives
- [Best Domestic Violence Books](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/resources/books): Curated book library on trauma recovery and abuse education resources

## Events & Recognition

- [Events for Domestic Violence Victims and Survivors](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/events): Calendar of national/local DV awareness events, webinars and conferences
- [Purple Ribbon Awards](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/awards): Annual awards program honoring excellence in domestic violence field

## Optional

- [Domestic Violence Article Library and Search Tool for Your Site](https://d3i11hp0zpbt87.cloudfront.net/resources/widgets): Embeddable widgets and article library for website integration
